External Communication

取消警告

Formal message to withdraw or annul a previously issued navigational, meteorological, or safety warning that is no longer in effect.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 取消警告?

In this glossary, 取消警告 refers to: Formal message to withdraw or annul a previously issued navigational, meteorological, or safety warning that is no longer in effect.

How is 取消警告 used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "全体船台，取消入口浮标附近的漂浮木头警告。危险已被清除，区域已宣布安全。"

Why does 取消警告 matter in maritime?

取消警告 matters because it supports clear communication in External Communication contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses 取消警告?

取消警告 is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does 取消警告 belong to?

In this glossary, 取消警告 is grouped under External Communication. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

Formal message to withdraw or annul a previously issued navigational, meteorological, or safety warning that is no longer in effect.

Operational example

All stations, cancel warning for floating log near entrance buoy. Hazard has been removed and area declared safe.

Localized term

取消警告

Localized example

全体船台，取消入口浮标附近的漂浮木头警告。危险已被清除，区域已宣布安全。
